source_selected.text: While sharing your data takes careful planning, notebooks make it easy to provide a description of your input data and upstream processing steps, which are essential for interpreting results.

In these cases, consider breaking down large and complex data sets into tiers such that, even if the raw data are prohibitively large to include alongside your published notebooks or are constrained by privacy or other access issues, reproducibility and interpretability isn’t lost.

You can host public copies of medium-sized, anonymized data in a variety of hosting services (for example, figshare [ https://figshare.com/ ], zenodo [ https://zenodo.org/ ]), and include further processed data sets alongside the notebooks in the final repository.
